items.source: Syntax sugar to create a PropertyReference from a method reference to a Java beans property.
items.translation: 语法糖用于从 Java Bean 的属性方法引用创建PropertyReference。

items.source: Extend the property to a property path by appending the next path segment and return a new property path instance.
items.translation: 将属性扩展为属性路径，通过追加next路径段，并返回一个新的属性路径实例。

items.source: property - the method reference to a Java beans property.
items.translation: property - 指向 JavaBean 属性的方法引用。

items.source: the typed property reference.
items.translation: 已输入的属性引用。

items.source: This method returns a resolved PropertyReference by introspecting the given method reference.
items.translation: 此方法通过内省给定的方法引用，返回一个解析后的 PropertyReference。

items.source: Get the property value for the given object.
items.translation: 获取给定对象的属性值。

items.source: Returns the name of the property.
items.translation: 返回属性的名称。

items.source: Returns the owning type of the referenced property.
items.translation: 返回所引用属性的拥有类型。

items.source: Returns the type information for the property at this segment.
items.translation: 返回此段中属性的类型信息。

items.source: Returns whether the property is a collection.
items.translation: 返回该属性是否为集合。

items.source: next - the next property path segment as method reference accepting the owner object P type and returning N as result of accessing the property.
items.translation: next - 作为方法引用的下一个属性路径段，该方法接受类型为 P 的拥有者对象，并返回访问该属性后的结果 N。

items.source: a new composed TypedPropertyPath.
items.translation: 一个新创建的 `TypedPropertyPath`。

items.source: This method returns a resolved PropertyReference by introspecting the given method reference. Note that get(Object) becomes unusable for collection properties as the property type adapted from Iterable <P> and a single P cannot represent a collection of items.
items.translation: 此方法通过内省给定的方法引用，返回一个解析后的 PropertyReference。请注意，get(Object) 对于集合属性将变得不可用，因为从 Iterable <P> 适配的属性类型与单个 P 无法表示项目集合。

items.source: Note that get(Object) becomes unusable for collection properties as the property type adapted from Iterable <P> and a single P cannot represent a collection of items.
items.translation: 请注意，由于从 `Iterable <P>` 适配的属性类型无法用单个 `P` 来表示项目集合，因此 `get(Object)` 对于集合属性将变得不可用。

items.source: The generic type parameters preserve type information across the property path chain: T represents the owning type of the current segment (or the root type for composed paths), while P represents the property value type at this segment. Composition automatically flows type information forward, ensuring that then() preserves the full chain's type safety.
items.translation: 泛型类型参数在属性路径链中保留类型信息：T 表示当前段（或组合路径的根）的所有者类型，而 P 表示该段的属性值类型。组合会自动将类型信息向前传递，确保 then() 保持整个链的类型安全性。

items.source: Implement PropertyReference using method references (strongly recommended) or lambdas that directly access a property getter. Constructor references, method calls with parameters, and complex expressions are not supported and result in PropertyResolutionException. Unlike method references, introspection of lambda expressions requires bytecode analysis of the declaration site classes and thus depends on their availability at runtime.
items.translation: 使用直接访问属性获取器的方法引用（强烈推荐）或 lambda 表达式来实现 PropertyReference。不支持构造函数引用、带参数的方法调用以及复杂表达式，这些会导致抛出 PropertyResolutionException。与直接的方法引用不同，对 lambda 表达式的内省需要分析声明位类的字节码，因此依赖于这些类在运行时的可用性。

items.source: This functional interface is typically implemented through method references that allow for compile-time type safety and refactoring support. Instead of string-based property names that are easy to miss when changing the domain model, PropertyReference leverages Java's declarative method references to ensure type-safe property access.
items.translation: 该功能接口通常通过方法引用来实现，从而支持编译时的类型安全和重构。与在修改领域模型时容易遗漏的基于字符串的属性名不同，PropertyReference 利用 Java 的声明式方法引用，确保属性访问的类型安全。

items.source: Returns the actual type of the property at this segment. Will return the plain resolved type for simple properties, the component type for any Iterable or the value type of Map properties.
items.translation: 返回此段属性上的实际类型。对于简单属性，将返回解析后的基本类型；对于任何 Iterable 或 Map 属性的值类型，将返回组件类型。

items.source: Interface providing type-safe property references.
items.translation: 提供类型安全的属性引用的接口。

items.source:
PropertyReference.property(Person::getName);
The resulting object can be used to obtain the property name and to interact with the target property. Typed references can be used to compose property paths to navigate nested object structures using then(PropertyReference): 
TypedPropertyPath<Person, String> city = PropertyReference.of(Person::getAddress).then(Address::getCity);
items.translation:
PropertyReference.property(Person::getName);
生成的对象可用于获取 属性名称 并与目标属性进行交互。类型化引用可用于组合 属性路径，以便通过 then(PropertyReference) 导航嵌套对象结构： 
TypedPropertyPath<Person, String> city = PropertyReference.of(Person::getAddress).then(Address::getCity);
